about_the_game:
CRUSH YOUR OPPONENTS AND BE THE MASTER OF THE ARENA!

Overall The Ball is a fun 2D party game played from 2 to 4 players in which victory is all that matters! A giant ball is in the arena, your goal: send it to your opponents! Get the most points before the time runs out and dominate the competition!

AN UNCONTROLLABLE BALL!

The ball only bounces around the edges of the arena and never stops! The more you hit it, the faster it will go!

PLAY CRAZY CHARACTERS : THE DEMINIS !

Do you prefer brute force, magic or a car? That, we let you decide. What is certain is that each Demini have their own abilities!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo E8400, 3.0GHz or AMD Athlon 64 X2 6000+, 3.0GHz or higher
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 9600 GT or AMD HD 3870 512MB or higher
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Overall The Ball is a party game played locally, from 2 to 4 players. Bounce a giant ball and eat your friends , play as colorful characters, use your abilities to take advantage and score points! Become the master of the arena!
